newsitem.title: USA: Midwest Express November traffic slides.
newsitem.headline: Midwest Express November traffic slides.

text.p: Midwest Express Holdings Inc said Tuesday its passenger load factor fell last month to 56.4 percent from 61.2 percent in November of 1995.

Midwest Express said revenue passenger miles topped 91 million, up from 84.2 million in November of 1995. The company said the available seat miles for Midwest Express in November reached 161 million, up from 138 million in November of 1995.

In the 11 months through November, load factor was 63.5 percent, down from 64.4 percent. The carrier had 1.1 billion revenue passenger miles, up from one billion in 1995, and 1.8 billion available seat miles, up from 1.6 billion.

Midwest Express said its Skyway Airlines unit's load factor was 41.1 percent last month, down from 42.4 percent in November in 1995. Skyway's revenue passenger miles reached 5.1 million, down from 5.3 million in the year-ago period.
The available seat miles for Skyway Airlines reached 12.5 million last month, down fractionally from one year ago.

For the 11 months through November, Skyway's load factor was 44.6 percent, up from 42.9 percent. Skyway had 148 million available seat miles, up from 144 million in 1995. Skyway had 66 million revenue passenger miles, up from 62 million.
Midwest Express operates two regional airlines.
